customLabels.description: global custom labels, applied to all resrouces

extraManifests.description: Extra manifests to deploy as an array

podSecurityContext.description:
Example podsecurity policy
More information available at:
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-standards/
podSecurityContext:
seccompProfile:
type: RuntimeDefault
runAsNonRoot: true
runAsUser: 10001
runAsGroup: 10001

prometheusRule.description:
Custom PrometheusRules to be defined
The value is evaluated as a template, so, for example, the value can depend on .Release or .Chart
ref: https://github.com/coreos/prometheus-operator#customresourcedefinitions

redisAddress.description: If serviceMonitor.multipleTarget is enabled, this configuration is actually not used

service.description:
- name: REDIS_PASSWORD
valueFrom:
secretKeyRef:
key: redis-password
name: redis-config-0.0.2

additionalMetricsRelabels.description:
for every targets, url and name must be set,
an individual additionalRelabeling can be set for every target
- url: "redis://myredis:6379"
name: "my-redis"
- url: "redis://my-redis-cluster:6379"
name: "bar"
additionalRelabeling:
- sourceLabels: [type]
targetLabel: type
replacement: cluster
additionalMetricsRelabels:
type: cluster

enabled.description: When set true then use a ServiceMonitor to configure scraping
